items.title: Roll Call
Acknowledge and Adopt Meeting Notice and Meeting Conduct Requirements Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
Chair’s Report
Executive Director’s Report
Approve the Minutes of the March 10, 2020 Meeting
[Final Approval] Appoint John Larson to the Citizens Advisory Committee
[Final Approval] State and Federal Legislation Update – ACTION*Support: Assembly Bill (AB) 2828 (Friedman)Conditional Support with Amendments: AB 2824 (Bonta)
[Final Approval] Adopt a Support Position for the Seamless Transit Principles
[Final Approval] Allocate $60,732,027 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for the Light-Rail Vehicle Procurement
[Final Approval] Allocate $1,819,800 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for Two Projects
[Final Approval] Amend the Adopted Fiscal Year 2019/20 Budget to Increase Revenues by $2.1 Million, Decrease Expenditures by $71.9 Million and Decrease Other Financing Sources by $67.0 Million
[Final Approval] Approve San Francisco’s Draft Plan Bay Area 2050 Fiscally Constrained Project List
[Final Approval] Award a Construction Contract to the Lowest Responsible and Responsive Bidder, Ghilotti Construction Company, Inc., in an Amount not to Exceed $29,684,453
[Final Approval] Extend the Vision Zero Committee of the Transportation Authority Until December 31, 2020
[Final Approval on First Appearance] Increase the Amount of Professional Services Contract with MNS Engineers, Inc. by $1,600,000, to a Total Amount Not to Exceed $4,600,000

[Final Approval on First Appearance] Authorize the Executive Director to Execute Amendments to the Memorandums of Agreement with Treasure Island Development Authority for Both the Right-of -Way Phase and Construction
Authorize the Executive Director to Execute a Memorandum of Understanding with the Transbay Joint Powers Authority

Allocate $11,906,558, with Conditions, for Downtown Rail Extension – Phasing and Partial 15% Design and Appropriate $2,636,109 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds for Rail Program Oversight and Project Development Support

Award a Two-Year Professional Services Contract to WMH Corporation, in an Amount Not to Exceed $3,000,000, for Engineering and Environmental Consulting Services for the U.S. 101/I-280 Express Lanes and Bus Project
Approve Programming Priorities for Up to $3,794,003 in San Francisco’s Estimated Fiscal Year 2020/21 State Transit Assistance County Block Grant Funds
Allocate $580,000 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds and $383,776 in Prop AA Vehicle Registration Fee Funds, with Conditions, for Three Requests
Introduction of New Items –
Public Comment
Adjournment
